Independent review accepts the inert canonical-restoration code/certificate successor at metadata head `514142defa84b1f023ffcaab003da87f7ee1e55c`, with the original scientific and source limits preserved. The changed executable was independently reviewed at `9f9049c6093c154a7a06111475332fb0ecb1b803`: https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/issues/1963#issuecomment-6185455760 .

I independently compared the complete original and successor JSON bodies. Only the one restorer critical pin, its matching application-input pin, both code-inventory references, and truthful metadata author identity differ. All 33 critical bodies were authenticated at the exact metadata head by mode, Git blob, length and SHA256 (370,706 bytes total). Initial source authentication, private decoded-buffer lifetime, copy bounds and final-target verification remain intact; all 20 focused controls passed in my prior code review.

I authenticated and inspected the complete unchanged qualification inventory, including all 18 phases / 171 recorded successful runs and 955 operating-custody entries, and independently checked its source-policy digest. I authenticated all seven selected-artifact binding bodies and the 343-product release catalogue; cross-checks preserve 49,625 locations, 49,623 unchanged records, the two original subjects, the 60 selected / 262,106 retained row split and the application representation's 1,498 literal unchanged records. The selected-binding fingerprint is unchanged. Original full product/operating/invocation qualification evidence is reused from the genuine prior review at https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/issues/1520#issuecomment-6090739618, whose live body and exact prior certificate/code hashes were checked; these original experiments are not claimed as fresh reruns.

The independently compared retained restoration manifests contain identical 764 paths / 502,181,105 bytes, modes and hashes. The author's 98.560288 s to 10.084982 s measurement is operational timing, not new source, geography or resource qualification.

This accepts the exact inert authority successor. Genuine retained GET registration, current caller/metadata binding, any required additive current-base rebind, applicable integration checks and normal exact-head review remain separate prerequisites to activation. It does not establish a completed current package/build, deployment, new repair or scientific replay.
